risks: CSS Module selectors include filename/local prefixes and must be verified against generated browser DOM; explicit data-ui-target anchors are preferable.
page=/ has guest/member/reader/CET state; path alone cannot choose mounted targets.
Portals/nested dialogs/mobile sheets can be outside the origin page and hidden/inert; do not select first hidden match.
CSS can change appearance/position, but must not replace handlers, controlled input state, contenteditable, token selection, scroll ownership or business actions.
Canvas/WebGL/GSAP/image transition effects need specialized adapters, not generic duration/transform overrides.
Admin panels, account usage bars and global error banners still need stable markers before editing.
Mobile and day/night variants must have distinct overrides and keyboard/reduced-motion verification.
Data-driven lists should be styled by template IDs; avoid storing customer article IDs or account-specific generated text.
